description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for managing mac80211 wireless interfaces, including setup, configuration, capabilities, and driver management for wireless devices in a Linux environment.

methods.name: init_wireless_driver
methods.description: Initializes the wireless driver setup.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Configures and sets up a mac80211 wireless interface based on JSON configuration.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the mac80211 interface configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if the interface has an access point.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets the interface name based on prefix and type.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with configuration from JSON.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_iw_htmode
methods.description: Prepares the HT mode for iw commands based on configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh parameters to JSON configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Sets up an adhoc wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Sets up a mesh wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor mode interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets transmit power for a virtual interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes wpa_supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd for a physical interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts wpa_supplicant on a physical interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Sets up wpa_supplicant for a virtual interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Prepares and configures a virtual interface.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves frequency for a given channel and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Disables scanning for a specific interface.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets the configuration of a physical interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for interface naming based on radio.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds the physical wireless device based on various identifiers.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames PHY based on board configuration path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames PHY based on board configuration name.

methods.name: list_phy_interfaces
methods.description: Lists network interfaces associated with a PHY.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Gets the board configuration name for a PHY.
